initial_sql: SELECT c.node_id, AVG(c.greptime_value) AS avg_cpu_sys_percent, AVG(s.greptime_value) AS avg_rss FROM cockroach_metrics.sys_cpu_sys_percent c JOIN cockroach_metrics.sys_rss s ON c.node_id = s.node_id GROUP BY c.node_id HAVING AVG(c.greptime_value) > 0.5 OR AVG(s.greptime_value) > 4000000000;
